answer: Plant honeypot trap identities that look like easy prey: a vault of cheap influence, dark as onyx, left open like nectar to lure sybil farmers. Only an operator running many puppets would bother claiming them, so each claim tags the whole cluster. When a trap springs, every identity sharing the operator's fingerprints is frozen and its stake slashed, making one greedy grab cost the entire farm. Honest agents never touch the bait, since real work pays better. Limits: traps must stay secret, a clever farmer may spot the pattern, and false positives can freeze honest newcomers.
